features: 2K (3MP) indoor pan/tilt camera; 355 pan / 52 tilt for near blind-spot-free full-room coverage
Motion and human detection with auto motion tracking and instant phone push alerts
Works with Google Assistant; supports RTSP protocol
Local microSD storage up to 128GB plus optional cloud storage (30-day free trial)
Live-stream sharing with up to 3 family members; baby / pet / nanny monitor

frigate.notes: Wansview states the G2 supports RTSP; the exact RTSP path/port is not published on the product page. Enable RTSP in the Wansview Cloud app and verify on device.

home_assistant.notes: RTSP is supported per the product page but no ONVIF is documented; add as a generic RTSP camera once the stream URL is confirmed.

blue_iris.notes: Use the RTSP stream (path not published); otherwise Wansview Cloud app.
